scope: Universal first-match table construction theorem plus exact finite coverage of all22 current invocations and all256 byte values. Macro algorithm mapping reviewed against complete native proc-macro source; compiler/syn/quote semantics external.
limitations: No full token progress, UTF-8 return-boundary, restart, arithmetic or tokenizer correctness proof.
Extractor is not a verified Rust parser; strict supported grammar and independent literal interpretation reduce shared-classifier risk.
Two general macro counterexamples concern guards and exclusive ranges absent from current invocations, not browser bugs.
